_comment: Angels guild layer for 3s. Essence (gp1) and Possession Health (gp2) come off the DEFAULT hpbar prompt 'H: hp/max[d]|php/phpmax[d] E: ess/max[d]...' via katmud_lib/angel.py - GMCP sends neither and MIP/FFF is gone mud-side (2026-09-15). Both maxima are stated by the prompt, not self-calibrated; possession is 0/0 when corporeal. A custom hpbar gets no bars. Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).
Pool labels CONFIRMED by matching score's Gp1/Gp2 to the named gscore readout on 2026-06-15.

Consecration = GMCP Guild.State 'spec' (equals the prompt's C:), max 100. A RESERVOIR, not a timer: fills to 100 while unused, drains while consecrating, refills after 'cease'. Do not add a reset learner.

Attack: 'kill first' - self-targets ONE mob (the first), so Hunt fights one at a time. Alt 'kill all' attacks every mob in the room at once (they all aggro you - riskier for solo hunting). Angels can self-target, unlike most 3s guilds which need an explicit target.
